answer_1.quote: Experimentally, our approaches significantly outperform the Transformer baseline by 1.08, 1.08, and 1.27 BLEU points on WMT 2014 English‑German, WMT 2014 English‑French, and WMT 2019 Chinese‑English, respectively. Moreover, our approaches generalize well to the text summarization task and achieve consistently better performance on two popular benchmarks, i.e., CNN/DailyMail and Gigaword.

answer_2.quote: We use multibleu.perl to calculate case sensitive BLEU scores for EN‑DE and EN‑FR, and use mteval‑v13a.pl script to calculate case sensitive BLEU scores for ZH‑EN. We report the F1 scores of ROUGE‑1, ROUGE‑2, and ROUGE‑L.
